commit_message:
fix(#3): drop leaf-bound factory classmethods from stores; RedisList element codec; append creates list

- store_from_source / store_from_sourced_object module-level functions replace
  RedisFactories on the store classes (wrappers re-exported them leaf-bound,
  returning unscoped stores over the whole keyspace)
- RedisList(encode=, decode=) applied on every read/write; RedisCollection passes
  list_encode/list_decode down
- RedisList.append uses RPUSH (RPUSHX silently dropped values on a missing list)
- fakeredis tests that run without a server

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
